newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foster's sees China losses steady.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foster's sees China losses steady.

text.p: Losses from Foster's Brewing Group Ltd's fledgling China operations for the year ending June 30, 1997 would be similar to the losses reported in 1995/96, Foster's said on Monday.
"There has been some definite progress in our business in China although our proft outcome is heading towards the same level as 1995/96," Fostser's chief executive Ted Kunkel said.

He told reporters the final result for 1996/97 would be A$1 million or A$2 million, "either side" of last year's losses. Kunkel said Foster's still aimed for its Chinese operations, which comprise of three breweries, to break even in around 1999.
